title:
Your AI team.
One shared space.
subtitle: A 3D workspace for understanding agent status.
narration: What if you could see your AI team at work? Bot Office turns agent status into a workspace you can understand at a glance.

title:
Different roles.
Clear purpose.
subtitle: Research / QA / Marketing / Product / Data
narration: Meet a demo team for research, quality assurance, marketing, product planning, and data analysis. Each role has its own place in the office.

title:
A desk that
fits the task.
subtitle: Source review. Test plans. Campaigns. Experiments.
narration: Research gets source-review screens. Quality assurance gets test-review screens. Marketing gets a campaign workspace. The details make each role easy to recognize.

title:
Walk. Sit.
Get to work.
subtitle: Continuous movement through a shared floor.
narration: Watch the bots walk to their desks, sit, and type. In the simulation, completed work can travel to the lead office before a bot returns to the lounge.

title:
You control
the view.
subtitle: Rotate / Pan / Zoom / Day to night
narration: Rotate the office, zoom into a workstation, or change the lighting from day to evening and night. The environment stays easy to explore.

title:
Demo is demo.
Live is separate.
subtitle: Illustrative personas. No third-party integrations.
narration: This footage is simulated. The named AI personas are not connected services. A separate password-protected mode displays status pushed by the real bot team.

title:
From systems
to experiences.
subtitle: Explore the code. Let us build something useful.
narration: Built with TypeScript and Three.js, with a Cloudflare backend for live status. Explore Bot Office on GitHub, and let us build something useful together.
